title: Long Short-Term Memory
blurb: Adds a gated, additively updated memory cell to recurrent networks so error signals can flow across long time lags.
intro: The LSTM keeps a cell state that is updated additively and protected by multiplicative gates: input and output gates in the original paper, and the forget gate added by Gers et al. in 2000, which every modern LSTM includes. The steps build the gates, a single cell forward and backward, and a bidirectional LSTM; the capstone evaluates an LSTM language model over a padded batch.

steps.name: Bidirectional LSTM over a padded batch
